values.AssociatedLNGNotes: The Mobile Bay Lateral Extension was approved to carry regasified LNG from the Gulf LNG import terminal near Pascagoula to Florida Gas Transmission's system. A Natural Gas Intelligence article on the federal environmental review says so. The export flag stays blank because no source ties this line to exports.

verifications.note: A Natural Gas Intelligence article on FERC environmental assessments for Transco and Florida Gas Transmission. It names the Mobile Bay Lateral Extension, a nine-mile extension, and says it would connect regasified LNG from the Gulf LNG Clean Energy import terminal.

records.researcher_notes: Matched to the 2011 Mobile Bay Lateral Expansion row by capacity and route. The article gives 342,610 MMBtu/d for the extension, which is close to the row's 343 MMcf/d. The article calls it the Mobile Bay Lateral Extension, so the name differs. Confidence is medium. Import terminal only, so the export flag is blank. Terminal name is the one in the terminal list, Gulf LNG Terminal.

ledger.note: The EIA text says this loop serves a local utility, Tampa Electric Company's Peoples Gas System, and it was cancelled. Two searches on Florida Gas Transmission and LNG found no tie to LNG export or import.
The EIA text for the East Leg Expansion gives no LNG link. Two searches on the Florida Gas Transmission family found no tie to LNG export or import for this segment.
The EIA text for the Jacksonville Expansion gives no LNG link. The searches on the Florida Gas Transmission family found no tie to LNG export or import for this segment.

A Natural Gas Intelligence article on the environmental review says the Mobile Bay Lateral Extension would connect regasified LNG from the Gulf LNG import terminal near Pascagoula to Florida Gas Transmission's system. The 2011 row matches that line by capacity and route, but the article uses the name Extension. Import tie only, so the export flag stays blank.
The EIA text describes a compressor station change in Mississippi that serves gas demand in Mobile County, Alabama, with no LNG mention. The searches found no LNG tie for this project.

Left blank, not confirmed.
